name: Hongrun Construction Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Hongrun Construction Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the construction business in China and internationally. It is involved in rail transit construction; municipal engineering; highway bridges; underground spaces; integrated pipe corridors; water and environmental protection; marine engineering; building construction; real estate development; infrastructure project investment and construction; and investment in high-tech industries, including green new energy, intelligent manufacturing, and robotics technology applications.
